input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

This isn't the CSV writer — it's the ingest-time dedupe logic. `dedupeKey` builds its key from `[t.date, t.amount, t.description]` only (src/ingest/dedupe.ts), so two transactions that match on those three fields but differ in currency (e.g. 10.00 EUR vs 10.00 USD) hash to the same key and are collapsed into one during `dedupe()`/`keysFor()`. Since currency was only added to transactions as of 3.2.0 (per CHANGELOG), this previously-safe key stopped being unique. The exporter in `src/export/csv.ts` only ever sees the already-deduped set, so it just faithfully prints whichever row survived ingest.

Fix should add `t.currency` to the key in `dedupeKey`.
